title: Avoid lowercase allocations in EXISTS membership cache keys
description: Replace temporary String allocations from to_ascii_lowercase in EXISTS membership cache key construction with direct ASCII-lowercase appends.

criteria: Production EXISTS membership key builders do not call to_ascii_lowercase for column names.
Generated cache key bytes match the previous format.
Correlated EXISTS and NOT EXISTS membership regressions pass.

notes: Added a private ASCII-lowercase append helper that preserves non-ASCII bytes exactly as str::to_ascii_lowercase does.
Added private unit tests comparing helper and cache key output against the legacy to_ascii_lowercase format.
The remaining to_ascii_lowercase matches in the touched file are only in tests that assert legacy equivalence.
